input: Bulan, Sorsogon — Due to the approaching tropical cyclone, the Office of the Municipal Mayor announces the suspension of face-to-face classes at all levels effective 2:00 PM today, until lifted.

actions: Suspend face-to-face classes at all levels
expected.summary: Face-to-face classes at all levels are suspended from 2:00 PM today until lifted due to a tropical cyclone.
